Hi Liam,

Thank you again for letting Redwood run the 3-week pilot with FinLytics. The team and I appreciated how quickly your engineering team iterated on the integration — we learned a lot about your throughput profile which helped tune batching and KV caching.

Quick recap from our end (details attached):
- Latency: median generation latency dropped from ~420ms baseline to ~190ms for your 128-token avg requests (55% improvement)
- Cost: estimated per-1M tokens unit cost decreased ~38% after prefix caching + INT8 quantization on the candidate model
- Availability: during the pilot we sustained 95th percentile latency SLAs under your peak load simulation (10 RPS sustained).

Would FinLytics be willing to provide a short quote (1–2 lines) summarizing the impact, and approve a 15-minute reference call with a product/marketing contact? We want to highlight the specific metrics above in a case study and would like to confirm the exact numbers with you before publishing.

If helpful, here are two quick options:
1) A 1–2 sentence quote we can publish + permission to use your logo; or
2) A 15-minute call for a couple of direct quotes and an internal contact who could speak to the results.

If you prefer, we can draft a suggested quote for you to edit. Appreciate any timing that works — even a brief thumbs-up is great.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
